findings.note: Rotowire (Oct 31): Reid went 0-for-6 from three in 36 minutes against the 76ers after a poor shooting night against the Wizards, and was benched for the second half against the Pistons. It also says his output may drop once Coby White (calf) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring) return.

Game log shows Reid made 4, 3, 5 and 2 threes (on 8+ attempts each) in his first four games, then 1 (13-minute benching game) and 0. He is the starting big with heavy shot volume while White and Knueppel are out, and his status for this game was not found.
In the Oct 21 game against this same Nets team, Reid went 4-for-10 from three with 20 points in 33 minutes, clearing 1.5 made threes easily.

In a Nov 3 report, CBS/RotoWire said Collins scored four points or fewer for the fourth straight game (4 points, 3 rebounds in 19 minutes vs CHA), averaging 8.4 points and 6.6 rebounds across seven games; that is about 15 points plus rebounds, below the 17.5 line.
Covers' Nov 4 model projects Collins for 12.09 points (over 11.5) and 5.99 rebounds (under 6.5); added together that is about 18.1 points plus rebounds, slightly above the 17.5 Under line.

The NBA.com game log shows Collins had 16 points and 11 rebounds (27 combined) in 34 minutes at PHI on Oct 25, then his minutes fell to 18-27 with 6-13 points plus rebounds in four games since, so this opponent has gone well over the line once already.

NBA.com has Thompson averaging 9.7 PPG in about 26 minutes. In his last five games he scored 14, 11, 7, 11 and 4, and the 4 came in a game he left hurt. He has cleared 9.5 in four of his six games this season, with a season-high 14 on 5-of-7 shooting on Nov 2.

RotoWire notes on CBS call Thompson mainly a defensive player who 'isn't a threat offensively on a night-to-night basis', and say his minutes and offensive role are worth watching. They also cover his recent right ankle sprain, which kept him out of the Oct 25 game against Philadelphia.

The Pistons page lists the game as 7-1 Philadelphia at 6-1 Detroit on Nov 4 at 7:00 pm ET. The same page has a note that a Pistons player named Jones missed his fourth straight game, with Wednesday against the 76ers as his next chance to play. Today's injury report for this game wasn't found.

Miller's season averages are 25.6 points, 6.2 rebounds and 1.8 assists in 33.8 minutes, which adds up to about 33.6 PRA, above the 30.5 line. He is carrying a bigger load while Coby White (calf) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring) are out. No game-day injury report was found.
Against these same Nets on Oct. 21, Miller had 18 points, 3 rebounds and 1 assist (22 PRA) on 7-of-21 shooting in 36 minutes. His shot volume was still very high.

RotoWire says his results swing a lot: he has scored under 20 points three times and over 30 three times. His logged PRA totals are 22, 8, 45, 46, 46, 28 and 34, so he went over 30.5 in 4 of 7 games, and his shooting efficiency has been poor.
